notes: USYDIS is a University of Sydney-wide competitive higher-degree-by-research stipend scholarship for international students; the University does not attach named supervisors to the award, so the listed professors are University of Sydney HDR supervisor/eligible research faculty relevant to the scholarship's PhD and MPhil candidature (examples across Faculty of Medicine and Health, Arts and Social Sciences, and Science). Scholarship terms: https://www.sydney.edu.au/content/dam/corporate/documents/scholarships/rtp-scholarships-/updated-tcs---usydis.pdf

Deakin Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship 100% (South Asia) is an academic-merit COURSEWORK scholarship for international students commencing Bachelor's or Master's by coursework degrees (https://www.deakin.edu.au/study/fees-and-scholarships/scholarships/find-a-scholarship/international-vice-chancellors-scholarship-100-south-asia). Selection is based on academic results plus a personal statement and referee reports; no research supervisor or programme faculty is attached to the award, so supervisor enrichment is not applicable. Scholarship enquiries: Deakin University South Asia office.

UTS Vice-Chancellor's International Undergraduate Scholarship is a tuition-fee merit scholarship for commencing international undergraduate students (https://www.uts.edu.au/for-students/admissions-entry/scholarships/scholarships-search/uts-vice-chancellors-international-undergraduate-scholarship). Award is based on academic merit in the school qualification used for admission; it is not tied to any professor, supervisor or research programme. Contact: UTS Future Learner Recruitment and Admissions, reps@uts.edu.au.

QUT International Merit Scholarship is a coursework academic-merit scholarship for future international undergraduate and postgraduate students (https://www.qut.edu.au/study/fees-and-scholarships/scholarships/international-merit-scholarship). Eligibility is determined solely on the academic record; no supervisor, programme director or faculty member is attached to the award, so supervisor enrichment is not applicable.

RMIT Future Leaders Scholarship is an automatic merit-based tuition fee reduction for international students from India and the subcontinent commencing eligible Bachelor's and Master's by COURSEWORK programs (listed under RMIT's 'Scholarships for commencing international students / Coursework scholarships' at https://www.rmit.edu.au/scholarships/international-scholarships, Future Leaders Scholarship: https://www.rmit.edu.au/scholarships/international-scholarships/future-leaders-scholarship). No separate application, no supervisor or research group attached; supervisor enrichment is not applicable.

notes: FIPRS requires applicants to have secured supervisor agreement before application: 'You must make contact with an academic staff member in your relevant academic area, and have an agreement from that person to supervise you if you are successful. Email evidence of the supervisor's agreement should be included with your application. Applicants who do not have a supervisor at the time of application will not be considered for an AGRTPS/FIPRS' (https://www.flinders.edu.au/scholarships/flinders-university-international-research-scholarship). The 'Find a research supervisor' page (https://www.flinders.edu.au/international/apply/apply-research-degree/find-research-supervisor) directs applicants to the Research @ Flinders supervisor register (https://researchnow.flinders.edu.au/en/persons/), which returned HTTP 403 to automated fetching; the College HDR Coordinators listed on the official HDR contacts page manage the Register of HDR supervisors and are the named programme faculty evidenced here.
